rule: If positional competition is UNSCOREABLE, Playing Pathway is UNSCOREABLE, regardless of whether rotation remains measurable. Rotation stays measurable and explainable; it simply does not carry a rank-bearing Playing Pathway score alone.
why: Rotation answers "how widely has this programme historically shared minutes?". It does not independently answer "how realistic is this athlete's pathway to minutes at this position when they arrive?". Selected on evidence semantics, not ranking stability.

diagnosticSimulationObserved.note: Observed in the A7.45 read-only simulation. Expectations, NOT targets to force. Measured against the pre-A7.44 baseline on a corpus whose pool has since grown.
